en: A hand‑colored historic postcard showing a broad market square lined with two‑ and three‑story traditional buildings with red tiled roofs. Prominent signage includes the 'Hotel zur Tanne' with an entrance arch labeled 'Hall Saal' and another shop labeled 'Gustav Müller'. A few people in early 20th‑century dress stand near the hotel entrance. The foreground is an open cobbled or dirt square. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene as the market of Neustadt i. S., and credits the publisher Brück & Sohn, Meissen, with an additional note that this is a hand‑colored artist card.
